newsitem.title: USA: Patriot completes Calif. Jockey merger.
newsitem.headline: Patriot completes Calif. Jockey merger.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc and California Jockey Club have completed their merger agreement after shareholders from both companies approved the deal.

Patriot also said in a statement on Tuesday its board approved a two-for-one stock split in the form of a stock dividend. The record date for the stock split will be July 15, 1997 with the anticipated date for mailing the new certificates July 25.
Trading of paired shares of California Jockey and Bay Meadows Operating Co on the American Stock Exchange ended at the close of business July 1, 1997.
